About

Max Schmidt, B.Eng

"I create films to make people feel something." — restless and wild.

The sea got me before the camera did.

Rock 'n' roll, old Detroit steel, vintage boats, film and technology — that's me. I'm a passionate filmmaker and engineer. For more than ten years I've gained experience as a producer in the radio world, as a freelance technician, an entrepreneur in film production, and as an engineer working on the biggest superyachts in the industry worldwide.

For me, films are pure art — the combination of technology and art to create something unique. It doesn't matter if you only have audio or video, as long as it moves you.
